purpose: Name the four-contact step counter used by the type-0x42 player-collision handler.

owner.name: ActorType42_PlayerCollisionHandler
owner.increment: Increment at 0x001AF270 for each nonterminal type-0x42 player collision.
owner.threshold: When the value exceeds 3, clear it and call InteractionCounter_AdvancePrimaryDigits.
owner.tail: Reinitialize the actor through the shared collision-template path.

evidence: Exact increment, threshold, clear, and counter-advance instructions
conclusion: FFF10A is a type-0x42 collision-step counter; it is not a general interaction counter or actor response timer.
